scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:mine: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.mine.toml && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.mine.toml
scripts.db:init: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=seed.local.sql
